minimization.validStandaloneRepro: ESC[H 中 ESC[H ESC[31m a (concatenate without spaces)
minimization.correction: Original difference is NOT an unused width-0 spacer. After overwriting the wide leading cell, column 1 becomes an ordinary width-1 blank. Native blank fg=default; xterm blank fg=palette1. Leading red a and cursor are equal at this point.
minimization.source: alacritty Term::write_at_cursor (term/mod.rs 993-1001) removes the following WIDE_CHAR_SPACER flag but does not update its foreground. Installed xterm InputHandler.print clears the old wide cell using setCellFromCodepoint(...,0,1,currentAttr), applying the new foreground.
minimization.followup: SGR32 + X overwrites blank and restores exact equality. ICH moves discrepant blank. CUP column2 + SGR0 + combining acute causes actual glyph/cursor divergence: native a+acute and cursor[1,0], xterm a and cursor[2,0]. This latter failure is a separate combining-after-control semantic and must not be asserted as causal proof that blank foreground alone changes visible output.

c1.raw9b324a: native prints 2J; xterm treats as CSI ED
c1.raw9d41: native prints A; xterm starts OSC
c1.source: vte0.15 lib.rs advance_ground: invalid raw byte <=0x9F goes to performer.execute; ground_dispatch also routes decoded U+0080..U+009F to execute. ansi.rs Processor::execute 1296-1307 implements listed C0 only; C1 ignored. xterm uses its own C1 terminal state machine.
c1.publicAPI: xterm5.5 IParser exposes CSI/DCS/ESC/OSC registration but NO registerExecuteHandler (confirmed typings and runtime). ESC handler cannot intercept raw/decoded IND and CSI/OSC handlers run after parser state transitions, too late to undo consumed byte streams.
c1.decision: No supported public adapter proven for full shared semantics. Deleting/translating C1 would change business bytes/protocol and is prohibited. Do not claim provider fixes parser-policy differences. No unverified dependency upgrade.

recommendedNextProductionPlan: Advance real native renderer/host prototype and gather actual embedding, input, resize, GPU-present and PTY evidence independently; do not gate native main-path work on a universal dual-core equivalence promise.
Keep original session identity and broker transport, ordered events, bounded backpressure, fixed native response authority. Do not detach/replace decoder core when changing native renderer surfaces.

Treat existing real xterm emulator as an independently selected session renderer, not a guaranteed live lossless migration target. This is risk isolation, not fulfillment or silent reduction of the user's requested lossless toggle; explicit product/user decision remains required.

If live cross-core equivalence remains mandatory, obtain supported upstream parser/combining/erase semantic hooks or own a version-pinned, audited fork with maintained differential contract. This is an architectural cost/blocker; do not adopt a private patch automatically.

Alternative canonical parser plus two presentation adapters would need explicit approval and a real xterm presentation implementation; current xterm is NOT being rebranded as a grid renderer or fallback proof.
Keep all five strict failures blocking; passing diagnostic counterexample tests are not equivalence successes.
